# Rudis — Financing Readiness Checklist

**Purpose:** prepare Rudis for serious strategic financing without overstating maturity or weakening founder autonomy.

## A. Corporate / contracting readiness

- [ ] Identify the legal person that will sign the financing / R&D agreement.
- [ ] Confirm tax residence and accounting setup.
- [ ] Establish project bank account / treasury controls where required.
- [ ] Define founder role and authority in the contracting vehicle.
- [ ] Define how existing founder-held IP is licensed or transferred, if at all.
- [ ] Avoid representing a future entity as owner before valid transfer/license exists.

## B. IP / chain of title

- [x] Public AGPL scope mapped at policy level.
- [x] Documentation / Corpus rights mapped at policy level.
- [ ] Brand / trademark assets fully mapped.
- [ ] Private implementation assets fully inventoried.
- [ ] Material contributor rights individually verified.
- [ ] Third-party components and licenses fully inventoried.
- [x] Unknown / unclear material has an explicit HOLD classification rule for commercial claims.
- [x] External precedents must be recorded without unsupported ownership claims.

## C. Security / disclosure

- [x] Public-repository publication pre-flight materially implemented.
- [x] Historical metadata residuals tracked.
- [x] No known public credentials / tokens / private keys from targeted review.
- [x] NDA data-room levels defined.
- [x] Restricted review protocol defined.
- [x] Vulnerability disclosure path defined.
- [x] Exact private candidate data never made public by default.

## D. Technical diligence

- [x] Current PRE-D3 status stated accurately in the external pack.
- [ ] Exact candidate can be frozen internally for partner review.
- [ ] Reproducibility evidence available on the final converged candidate or open limitation stated.
- [ ] Known FAIL / HOLD register current at moment of external diligence.
- [x] Independent review responsibilities defined by PRE-D3 process.
- [x] Demo policy forbids implying production readiness.
- [x] Claims must map to evidence handles or public evidence.

## E. Commercial model

- [x] Strategic R&D proposal prepared.
- [x] Initial USD 12M staged structure prepared.
- [x] Optional later USD 15M field program clearly non-automatic.
- [x] Revenue hypotheses separated from forecasts.
- [x] Categories of commercial rights identified subject to actual title / license.
- [x] No promise of exclusivity beyond rights actually held.

## F. Founder autonomy

- [x] Founder Strategic Reserve included in negotiation baseline.
- [x] Target reserve: not less than 10% of each funded tranche.
- [x] Founder ordinary operating/research discretion protected as negotiation objective.
- [x] Founder liquidity / compensation separated transparently from project OPEX.
- [x] No blanket assignment of present/future founder IP as default position.
- [x] No broad personal non-compete by default.
- [x] No disproportionate personal guarantees by default.
- [x] Unrelated future founder projects remain free unless a narrowly defined conflict is agreed.

## G. Budget / controls

- [x] Phase financing envelopes exist.
- [x] Founder Strategic Reserve is separately visible.
- [x] Founder compensation / liquidity mechanism is separately identified.
- [x] Management reallocation flexibility has a proposed baseline.
- [x] Reporting principle balances accountability with no transaction-level micromanagement.
- [ ] Definitive related-party transaction threshold to be set with counsel / investor.

## H. Partner rights

- [x] Internal evaluation rights concept defined.
- [x] NDA / confidentiality disclosure layers defined.
- [x] Technical access purpose-bound.
- [x] Commercial negotiation rights should be time-limited.
- [x] ROFN preferred to broad ROFR.
- [x] Exclusivity, if any, field-limited, time-limited and separately compensated.
- [x] Partner does not gain Rudis constitutional authority through funding.

## I. Legal / regulatory work before signing

- [ ] Spanish / applicable corporate counsel reviews structure.
- [ ] Tax adviser reviews founder compensation / liquidity / reserve mechanics.
- [ ] IP counsel or competent lawyer reviews chain of title and licensing.
- [ ] Data-protection review completed for shared data.
- [x] Financial-services / RU concepts are excluded from real operation unless separately authorized and licensed.
- [ ] Securities-law characterization reviewed if equity / convertible instrument is used.

## J. Outreach assets

- [x] Public one-pager.
- [x] RAL Public Architecture Brief.
- [x] Maturity & Limits Statement.
- [x] Sanitized Security Posture.
- [x] Disclosure Classification Matrix.
- [x] Demo Release Checklist.
- [x] IP / License / Provenance public matrix.
- [x] Meta NDA Data Room Index.
- [x] Restricted Review Protocol.
- [x] Financing Principles & Founder Autonomy Framework.
- [x] Strategic Financing Term Sheet Framework.
- [x] Funding Strategy & Target Ladder 2026.
- [x] External Contact / Financing Provenance Log template.
- [x] 8–10 slide strategic-partner deck content blueprint.
- [ ] Actual presentation artifact.
- [ ] 90–180 second sanitized demo video.
- [ ] Founder / project professional contact channel independent of compromised social accounts.
- [ ] Named target-person outreach list populated with real contacts.

## K. Release gate

The public / financing documentation is sufficiently structured for preliminary outreach and diligence preparation, but binding financing should wait until transaction-specific legal, tax, IP and contracting-vehicle questions are closed or expressly made conditions precedent.

```text
PRELIMINARY OUTREACH READY
= YES, SUBJECT TO CURRENT FACT CHECK BEFORE SEND

BINDING FINANCING READY
= NO, LEGAL / ENTITY / CHAIN-OF-TITLE WORK REMAINS
```

```text
CLEAN ENOUGH TO DILIGENCE
!=
EVERYTHING FINISHED
```

The objective is not to eliminate uncertainty; it is to make uncertainty legible, bounded and negotiable.
